nodes.label: Goal100 Gazebo integration and TD3 smoke — 2026-11-10
nodes.status: Gazebo short integration completed; long research training remained a proposal in this report

nodes.label: Goal100 Gazebo short qualification
nodes.summary: Gazebo Harmonic, Nino/caster URDF and simulated velocity PI executed 7 fresh launches under cap 8 and 970 native transitions. B0 succeeded 2/3; optimizer smoke and one deterministic development evaluation ran. All 238 manifest files matched; observer closures and PI readbacks were 7/7 each. Zero hardware and long-training jobs.
nodes.rationale: Integration success does not establish TD3 superiority or hardware readiness.

nodes.label: Locked Goal100 simulation task and geometry bank
nodes.summary: Straight 2 m route, nominal 0.20 m/s, source warmup 0.5 s, deadline 25 s. Development: clear floor and rigid Ø6 mm steps at 0.65/1.05 m; validation 1.25 m and test 1.50 m remained unused. Actor is sensor-only 100D at 10 Hz with one ±0.02 m/s common residual. PI readback Kp 0.3/Ki 0.1, configured 500 Hz, 4 Nm cap; torque residual zero. Conservative base_footprint collision envelope includes full continuous-joint/caster sweep and is checked against each loaded URDF.
nodes.rationale: This is a conservative simulation-model bound, not measured real-robot geometry or qualification of arbitrary factory obstacles.

nodes.label: B0 failure retention and software-smoke gate amendment
nodes.status: Original baseline stage remains failed; one documented amendment allowed software smoke
nodes.summary: Clear and early-step B0 reached goal and stopped; late-step B0 crossed the step but violated the 40 mm path gate at 40.564 mm. All three measurements were valid. Amendment permitted software smoke with valid data, clear-floor success and at least one step success while retaining the other failure. No B0 rerun or reward/history/action/physics/PI change.
nodes.rationale: The original all-layout B0 success gate mixed controller performance with environment validity; the amendment changed smoke eligibility without changing task success.

nodes.label: Goal100 384-transition optimizer smoke
nodes.summary: Smoke profile uses MLP 32×32, warmup 16, replay 2048, LR 0.0003 and batch 32. Executed 384 transitions, 368 critic and 184 actor updates; two completed episodes succeeded, 51 final steps stayed censored. Reloaded checkpoint/replay passed full audit. One frozen dev_late rollout succeeded in 154 steps/15.4 s, with goal error 18.47 mm and path RMSE/max 4.293/8.321 mm.
nodes.rationale: One failed B0 fresh launch and one successful learned-policy launch cannot identify causal benefit; this is one seed and development evaluation, not research-profile training.

nodes.label: Prepared fresh Goal100 research20k proposal
nodes.status: Prepared and preflighted; not launched in this report
nodes.summary: unknown_goal100_v1 / unknown_step_dev_bank_v1, fresh nino_td3_research_h5_v1 MLP 256×256, replay 100k, 20k steps, warmup 10k, seed 11, checkpoints every 5k and proposed 240-minute cap. B0/TD3 development evaluation proposed after training; validation/test reserved. Dispatcher v3 and GUI support exact identity; 117 software tests passed.
nodes.rationale: Common103 and smoke MLP32 checkpoints cannot be resumed as research MLP256. Measurement failure should stop work and preserve checkpoints; lack of benefit should trigger focused diagnosis rather than automatic extra steps or algorithms.
